Name: VoiceChat
Author: DailyXCZ
Description:
[center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/wmu1J1q.png[/img][/b][/center]

[center]Tired of typing? Bring your multiplayer farm to life with [b]VoiceChat[/b], a fully-featured, immersive voice chat mod for Stardew Valley. Talk directly with other farmers in your game, voices fade naturally with distance, pan left and right based on the speaker's position, and muffle through walls and doors, creating a co-op experience that actually feels like the world.

[size=4][b]Note: 1.3.0 is a breaking update.[/b][/size] Players on 1.1.1 or earlier will not be able to talk to players on 1.3.0. Coordinate the update with everyone in your session.

[img]https://imgur.com/15VQfWw.png[/img][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Installation: Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], then unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Configuration: Access all settings via the gear icon on the title screen, the Generic Mod Config Menu hotkey in-game, or by clicking the speaker icon at the top-left of the screen. Pick your microphone, speakers, and preferred activation mode.[/*]
[*]Talking
[list]
[*]If using Voice Activity, just start talking.[/*]
[*]If using Push-to-Talk, press and hold the assigned key (default: V) to speak.[/*]
[*]To whisper, hold the Whisper key (default: C) — your voice range temporarily drops to a few tiles for a private conversation.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Changing Proximity: Press the Cycle Proximity key (default: Z) to switch between the three hearing distances.[/*]
[*]Muting Someone: A small list of currently-talking players appears below the voice icon. Right-click a name to mute or unmute that player. Mutes are saved per save file.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/EHlXMKv.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Input Mode[/b]: Choose between [i]VoiceActivity[/i] and [i]PushToTalk[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Playback Volume[/b]: A master volume slider for all incoming voice chat.[/*]
[*][b]Push-to-Talk Key[/b]: Set your preferred key for PTT mode.[/*]
[*][b]Cycle Proximity Key[/b]: Set your preferred key to change hearing distance.[/*]
[*][b]Whisper Key[/b]: Hold this key to temporarily drop your voice range to a few tiles for private conversations.[/*]
[*][b]Noise Suppression[/b]: Toggle the RNNoise background noise filter. On by default for cleaner audio.[/*]
[*][b]Voice Activation Sensitivity[/b]: Adjust how loud you need to speak for your voice to be transmitted in Voice Activity mode.[/*]
[*][b]Sidetone[/b] / [b]Sidetone Volume[/b]: Optionally hear your own microphone played back through your headset, with adjustable volume. Useful with closed-back headsets where you can't otherwise hear yourself talk.[/*]
[*][b]Wall Occlusion[/b]: Muffle voices when a wall, door, or other structure stands between you and the speaker. On by default; disable for cleaner audio at the cost of immersion.[/*]
[*][b]Input/Output Device[/b]: Select your specific microphone and speakers/headset from a list of available devices. Changes apply live without a game restart.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/oJVKrcS.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]This mod requires all players in the multiplayer session to have it installed [b]on the same major version[/b]. Mismatched versions cannot hear each other.[/*]
[*]It has no effect in single-player mode.[/*]
[*]It is designed to be compatible with most other SMAPI mods.[/*]
[*]This mod is cross-platform, [b]Windows, macOS, and Linux (OSS/ALSA), [/b]and bundles the native libraries required to make that work.[/*]
[/list]
